text.tspan: FlashAttention 面试讲解画布：从 v1 到 v4 的优化主线

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
text.tspan: 核心问题：标准 Attention 不缺 FLOPs，先卡在显存 IO，后卡在如何持续喂满新 GPU 的 Tensor Core

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
text.tspan: 一、先讲清楚它到底解决什么

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
text.tspan: S = QK^T 生成 N x N 分数矩阵
问题：S 和 P 写回 HBM，长序列显存和带宽都爆

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
text.tspan: 不近似，不改变数学结果
把 K/V 分块搬进 SRAM
边算 QK，边做 online softmax，边累加 PV
避免物化完整 N x N 注意力矩阵

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
text.tspan: m：当前块最大值，用于数值稳定
新块到来时重缩放旧 O 和 l，再加新块贡献

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
text.tspan: 不是 sparse attention，也不是 low-rank 近似
时间复杂度仍是 O(N^2 d)
显存占用从存 N^2 中间矩阵转向 O(Nd)
优势来自 IO-aware kernel fusion 和 tiling

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
text.tspan: 二、v1 到 v4 的优化演进

-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
text.tspan: 减少非 matmul 和共享内存

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
text.tspan: 瓶颈：HBM 读写远慢于 SRAM
核心：Q 分块，K/V 分块，块内计算
不保存 S/P，反向只保存少量统计量
面试句：用更多计算重算换少写显存，

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
text.tspan: 瓶颈：v1 还没接近 GEMM，
occupancy 和 warp 通信不理想
核心：跨 thread block 并行单个
warp 内重新分工，减少 shared
面试句：算法思想不变，主要优化

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
text.tspan: 瓶颈：H100 上 Tensor Core 很快，
load 和 softmax 会拖后腿
核心：TMA 搬运 + WGMMA 计算异步
matmul 与 softmax 交错，FP8 低

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
text.tspan: 瓶颈：B200 Tensor Core 翻倍，但
shared memory 和 exp 单元没同步
核心：更深 fully async MMA
TMEM 存中间结果，2-CTA MMA 优
软件 exp 与条件 softmax rescale

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
text.tspan: v1：少搬数据 -> v2：多开并行 -> v3：异步重叠 -> v4：面向
Blackwell 重排 pipeline，削掉非矩阵瓶颈
